Here, we have a figure and we need to find the triangles in all.

Given: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7a3425b42f645b481a565772ac9ed12c7537416d7954d89c2bcbb497b0cba33.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cee4f243b8c6ffce470d2d6f15c87651a569ca9bf94c96b27d2ab037427f0743.png] 

Next, we will count the total number of triangles are: PSU, PSR, RSU, QST, QSO, OST. i.e. a total of 6 triangles. Similarly for the next triangle too (i.e. green colour).

Thus, a total number of triangles = 6 + 6 + 1 = 13 triangles,

Hence, there are __**13**__ triangles.
